svg.title: K-modes clusters
svg.desc: Cluster modes of 3 clusters from k-modes over categorical codes, over 4 variables. The size bar is the share of training rows in each cluster. Each cell is the share of the other clusters whose modal category differs on that variable, the same simple matching the model uses to assign rows: 1 means no other cluster shares the category, 0 means every cluster does.
svg.text: 3 clusters; how far each cluster's modal category stands apart
